name: Kaise Hayato
source:
A reckless and straightforward former police officer.

Once an exceptional police officer, he now works at L&L, where he serves as Chigaya’s bodyguard and looks after Zen when he’s out having fun. He’s the same age as his good friend and cousin, Shun.
